entries.title: Psalms 71:1
segments: ¶In You, O LORD, I put my trust; Let me never be put to shame.

entries.title: Psalms 71:2
segments: Deliver me in Your righteousness, and cause me to escape; Incline Your ear to me, and save me.

entries.title: Psalms 71:3
segments: Be my strong refuge, To which I may resort continually; You have given the commandment to save me, For You [are] my rock and my fortress.

entries.title: Psalms 71:4
segments: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, Out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

entries.title: Psalms 71:5
segments: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD; [You are] my trust from my youth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:6
segments: By You I have been upheld from birth; You are He who took me out of my mother's womb. My praise [shall be] continually of You.

entries.title: Psalms 71:7
segments: I have become as a wonder to many, But You [are] my strong refuge.

entries.title: Psalms 71:8
segments: Let my mouth be filled [with] Your praise [And with] Your glory all the day.

entries.title: Psalms 71:9
segments: Do not cast me off in the time of old age; Do not forsake me when my strength fails.

entries.title: Psalms 71:10
segments: For my enemies speak against me; And those who lie in wait for my life take counsel together,

entries.title: Psalms 71:11
segments: Saying, "God has forsaken him; Pursue and take him, for [there is] none to deliver [him]."

entries.title: Psalms 71:12
segments: O God, do not be far from me; O my God, make haste to help me!

entries.title: Psalms 71:13
segments: Let them be confounded [and] consumed Who are adversaries of my life; Let them be covered [with] reproach and dishonor Who seek my hurt.

entries.title: Psalms 71:14
segments: ¶But I will hope continually, And will praise You yet more and more.

entries.title: Psalms 71:15
segments: My mouth shall tell of Your righteousness [And] Your salvation all the day, For I do not know [their] limits.

entries.title: Psalms 71:16
segments: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will make mention of Your righteousness, of Yours only.

entries.title: Psalms 71:17
segments: O God, You have taught me from my youth; And to this [day] I declare Your wondrous works.

entries.title: Psalms 71:18
segments: Now also when [I am] old and grayheaded, O God, do not forsake me, Until I declare Your strength to [this] generation, Your power to everyone [who] is to come.

entries.title: Psalms 71:19
segments: Also Your righteousness, O God, [is] very high, You who have done great things; O God, who [is] like You?

entries.title: Psalms 71:20
segments: [You], who have shown me great and severe troubles, Shall revive me again, And bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 71:21
segments: You shall increase my greatness, And comfort me on every side.

entries.title: Psalms 71:22
segments: Also with the lute I will praise you-[And] Your faithfulness, O my God! To You I will sing with the harp, O Holy One of Israel.

entries.title: Psalms 71:23
segments: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing to You, And my soul, which You have redeemed.

entries.title: Psalms 71:24
segments: My tongue also shall talk of Your righteousness all the day long; For they are confounded, For they are brought to shame Who seek my hurt.
